title: A sound shows its fade in and fade out as the mock draws them
goal: The panel for a piece of sound shows how long it fades in and out, and the curve, as the audio mock draws them, instead of only a level fader.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-audio.html, #propBody Fades section (grid2 In/Out fields, Curve select). App: SoundInspector has only Level and Points/Flatten; its header comment argued fades are the level line, which departs from the mock (found in the-video-properties-look-like-the-rest-of-the-d). A fade can be written as level points at the ends so the model stays one line.
acceptance: With a sound picked, the panel has Fades In and Out values and a Curve dropdown as pages/video-audio.html draws them
Changing a fade changes the level line on the sound bar and what you hear, as one undo step
A walk with no flags sets a fade in on the sample music and reads it back
